title: Windrow House Rising Anew
author: Rosalind Dravenmoor
blurb: Coral Hartwell, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the trial begins.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
